gates.question: Is the frozen protocol intact and is the runtime self-consistent?
Are E010/PKLSA sources discoverable and are evaluated carriers individually provenance-qualified and hash-consistent?
Do analytic controls, SI dimensional scales, rigid-motion/orientation/resampling controls, and numerical sanity checks pass?
Are geometry descriptors and the regularized energy kernel numerically converged and more stable within topology than across topology?
Do preregistered held-out independence/provenance groups reproduce the discovery-side descriptor and energy structure?
Does strict native C++ FP64 reproduce Python/NumPy FP64 for the regularized energy matrix within 1e-10 relative L2?
If available, does framework GPU/DD32 screening evidence satisfy its frozen screening contract without being promoted to certification authority?
Does the result replicate across independent PKLSA source/provider families without pseudo-replication?
For multicomponent carriers, does self+mutual energy reconstruct total energy and yield finite, reproducible coherence spectra?
After a completed blind FULL/CERTIFY run, does commitment-verified reveal preserve protocol/output integrity and permit protected comparison?
Does the reduced candidate Lagrangian exhibit acceptably small Euler-Lagrange residuals on registered short trajectories?
Does the Legendre transform close and is the reduced Hamiltonian conserved to the registered numerical tolerance?
Is the finite-difference energy Hessian symmetric/converged, with gradient information explicitly separating stationary from nonstationary carriers?
Does the derived Jacobian spectrum agree with direct reduced integration for resolvable oscillatory modes?
Are target-free spectral ratios reproducible within topology across independent carriers?
Which preregistered geometry-only surrogate best predicts the finite-core energy kernel under topology-grouped cross-validation?
Does adding coherence/spectral information improve protected energy-kernel generalization enough to justify the added complexity?
Has a complete target-free topology prediction table, including anonymous registered composite constructions, been frozen before reveal?
Do the selected blind model families generalize to a protected topology holdout not used for surrogate fitting?
Can absolute SI predictions be generated from the frozen dimensionless kernel in both background-density and core-density lanes without observed target access?
Are primary conclusions robust to core regularization, discretization, carrier jackknife, and perturbation amplitude?
Do primary observables survive provider/lineage-group jackknife and independent evidence-family replication?
What is the blind evidence classification when all diagnostic gates are considered without treating earlier scientific failures as execution blockers?
